Build prompt

Build “Site & Shelter Safety Inspection Checklist” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Version the checklist, capture site, time and optional photo, and turn failed items into assigned corrective actions with a due date. Preserve the inspection as recorded. Inspectors create checks for assigned sites. Facilities staff own repair tasks. A supervisor reviews evidence and closes a finding. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

One failed lighting check on a six-item inspection creates one repair. Completing it leaves the original failed observation intact and a supervisor can close the finding with evidence.
